label: D2 update gate: high when S2 reached, low for S1 (deeper late-episode, after rewarded S1)
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * np.maximum(ep_dec - 5, 0)**2 ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * (prev_state == S2) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 25 sits near 0.98 at D1/GO (residuals there about 0.01 or less) and only varies at D2, where it encodes the reached state (observed at D2). Reaching S2 raises z by about 0.10 and choosing a2 adds about 0.06 more, so a2->S2 is highest and a1->S1 lowest. In S1 trials z falls further as the episode goes on (about -0.026 per episode decade, partly undone by a late hinge term), and it is about 0.07 lower again when the previous trial also reached S1 and was rewarded. The matching S2-after-rewarded-S2 term gets almost no weight. Choice x state alone: dev 0.53; adding the state x episode-decade interaction: 0.85; adding the previous-rewarded-S1 history: dev 0.885, test 0.885 (all ceiling 0.96). All terms are observed at D2; no future variables, and hidden good state or value were not needed.

issues: The 'late-episode deepening' and 'after rewarded S1' story stands in for the model's value estimate. Adding two value terms, (phase==D2)*(state==S1)*value and (phase==D2)*(state==S2)*value, to the choice x state terms shrinks the S1*ep_dec weight from -0.026 to -0.002. The hinge weight also flips sign, from +0.004 to -0.009. Test R^2 beyond timing rises from 0.885 to 0.955, against an 'all' ceiling of 0.96.

The explanation says the model's value output was not needed. That overclaims. A single (phase==D2)*value term plus the three choice x state terms already scores 0.892 test, more than the claimed 7-term set (0.885).

Misses on the claimed terms show a systematic error class. D2 after 'a1 S2 u' is over-predicted by 0.055 and D2 after '?' by 0.026. The worst windows are all early-episode (t2-t8) a1->S1 D2 steps: actual about 0.60 against predicted 0.72-0.80. So S1-reached z can be deeply low early in the episode too, which contradicts the purely 'late-episode' framing. With the value terms these errors fall to 0.03 or less.

The hidden variable 'good' also beats the rewarded-S1 history term: swapping it for good==1 / good==2 gives 0.895 test, against 0.885. This again suggests the history term is a belief proxy: z at D2 is lower when the reached state is believed to be good.

Some core claims hold: z sits near 0.98 at D1 and GO with residuals of 0.01 or less, a2->S2 is highest and a1->S1 lowest at D2, and the claimed terms reproduce 0.885 on both dev and test. The 0.53 -> 0.85 build-up also checks out (0.531 and 0.849 test).
